Snorlax

Normal

Kanto · Generation 1

Snorlax is a Normal-type Sleeping Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 2.1 m tall and weighs 460 kg. It evolves from Munchlax. Its highest base stat is HP (160), with a base stat total of 540.
